title: Genuine Zero Uniform Atlas Energy
description: Lean 4 formalization of the native real-camera/Genuine zero identity, faithful empirical C2--C7 camera geometry, exact cutoff-tail jets, and the finite-to-limit transverse-energy architecture. Version 0.14.0 closes the first quantitative continuation gate by proving an exact crosswalk between the empirical cameras and the spectral-Weyl camera library, transporting its all-order derivative-tail estimate, and deriving an explicit six-camera finite second-jet bound with the M^(-3/2) log(M)^2 rate. These identities use no supplied height and do not require simplicity; the existing quadratic coercivity route remains the multiplicity-one sector. The release does not promote the remaining denominator floors, fixed C/M constants, compact-region coverage, numerical evidence, or readout-domain equivalences to an unconditional confinement theorem.
